audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup is absent from every field: Renekton's empowered W (above 50 Fury) destroys damage shields on the target, and Sett's entire trade pattern is the Haymaker shield. The page instead says only 'burst after it'. Second omission: Facebreaker stuns only when enemies are on opposite sides of Sett — alone on one side you are slowed, not stunned.
audit.why: Both change how you commit. With 50 Fury banked you delete the shield instead of waiting out an 18s cooldown, and standing on the same side as the wave downgrades his stun to a slow.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — His shield + true-damage burst. Burst after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sett Haymaker: 18s at rank 1, and empowered W destroys the shield it gives him — 50 fury beats it. - Facebreaker: 16s, and it only stuns when you are on the opposite side from another enemy. - Dominus: 120s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Facebreaker stuns only with a minion on his far side — stay off it.

edits.before: Once Sett has absorbed 3-4 hits his Haymaker shield dwarfs your Q heal — this is his spike every trade; never hand him a full Grit meter.
edits.after: Once Sett banks Grit his shield dwarfs your Q heal — but empowered W destroys shields, so 50 fury erases it. Never trade a full bar at zero fury.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a genuine skill check. Sett's Grit stacks up fast if you trade repeatedly without backing off, and a full Haymaker into your face hits for true damage through your Q heal. Keep the wave frozen near your side so he has to walk up, then punish with one clean combo rather than two — every extra hit you land before getting out is Grit he banks for his counter-swing. At level 6 your Dominus HP buffer lets you absorb one Haymaker and survive; use that window to re-engage immediately after he pops it, since the cooldown leaves him shieldless.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a genuine skill check. Sett's Grit stacks fast if you trade repeatedly without backing off, and a full Haymaker hits for true damage through your Q heal — but empowered W destroys damage shields, so at 50 fury the shield half of it simply vanishes. Keep the wave near your side, and stand so no minion is on his far side: Facebreaker only stuns enemies on opposite sides of him, and alone you are merely slowed. At 6 your Dominus buffer absorbs one Haymaker; re-engage the instant he spends it, because it is 18s at rank 1 and he is shieldless until it returns.

edits.before: Use Facebreaker (E) to interrupt your E-dash approach or stun you mid-combo at the edge of his hitbox
edits.after: Catch you with Facebreaker (E) on the opposite side from a minion so it stuns instead of slows, then bank Grit

edits.before: Use The Show Stopper (R) to slam you into your own minion wave and chunked by AoE splash damage
edits.after: Slam you with The Show Stopper (R) into his team so the landing slow catches you and your escape
